newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan brokerages up on laggard buying.
newsitem.headline: Japan brokerages up on laggard buying.

text.p: Japan brokerages rose on Thursday morning as investors hurried to buy the shares, which are lagging behind rises posted by indices.
By midday Nomura Securities Co Ltd shares were up 80 yen at 1,580, with trade totalling 9.67 million shares.
A financial daily said on Thursday that the scandal-stricken brokerage earned the largest commission revenues among brokerages operating in Japan in May for the first time in three months.
A Nomura spokeswoman declined to comment on the report.
Daiwa Securities Co Ltd shares added 55 yen to reach 975 and Nikko Securities Co Ltd was up 52 yen at 766. Yamatane Securities Co Ltd was up 22 yen or 10.95 percent at 223 yen.
The securities sector was the largest gaining sector on the Tokyo bourse.

"It isn't as if new factors have arisen to persuade investors to buy brokerage shares. Most of the buying is coming from funds trying to bring up the weight of brokerages in portfolios," a trader at a second-tier brokerage said.
"The same sort of buying has been lifting banking sector shares recently."
